params.body:
During the review (`PRELAUNCH_REVIEW`) the homepage leaves out the trends and the report band, so the coloured figures band comes straight before "How we read". On a wide screen that scene has no padding of its own, and its heading sat against the band's lower edge.

For a visitor in review mode the scene now gets `lg:pt-24` above it. A member's homepage is unchanged: there the report band ends in a thin line on paper. Phones were not affected, since the scene has its own padding there.

Checked by adding the same padding to the live page in a browser: the heading now stands clear of the band. `PreLaunchTest`, which renders the review homepage, passes.
params.title: Room above How we read during the review
